title: CD-SEM Measurement - Voids Detection on 2920 Series
subtitle: Post-Etch Quality Validation for 65nm Node Manufacturing
author: Michael Torres

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the 2920 Series system to detect and classify Voids defects during post-etch inspection at the 65nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 12 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 300mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Voids defects that are critical to yield at the 65nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the 2920 Series platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: 2920 Series
- Inspection Type: CD-SEM Measurement
- Target Defect: Voids
- Process Step: Post-Etch
- Wafer Size: 300mm
- Technology Node: 65nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 12

This test case applies to all 2920 Series systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 12 for post-etch monitoring in the 65nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: 2920 Series
Software Version: v13.7.767
Recipe: CD-SEM_MEASUREMENT_65nm_POST_ETCH
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (156 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the 2920 Series system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'CD-SEM Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Voids defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 65nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 78 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 97% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±0.9% for CD-SEM Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.95 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-03-29
Wafers Tested: 47
Total Defects Found: 3286
Defect Density: 464.87 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 4.9%
Capture Rate: 87.1%
Test Duration: 183 minutes
System Uptime: 97.4%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The 2920 Series demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Voids at the 65nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Throughput metrics met production requirements without sensitivity compromise.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
